tracker.monthly_note: June 2026 remains Under Pressure: five KPIs are Under Pressure, one is on Watch and two are On Track. Total Revenue & Grants is 9.8% below its YTD baseline, driven in part by Non‑Tax Revenue at 51.8% below baseline. The Primary Balance is 75.2% below baseline, while the Fiscal Balance records a J$23.76 billion deficit against a planned J$25.81 billion surplus. Capital Expenditure is also 22.0% below pace. In the next official release, watch whether revenue collections recover, the primary and fiscal balance gaps narrow, and capital spending moves closer to plan.

extras.approved_email_summary: April 2026 opened the FY 2026/27 Budget Performance Tracker under pressure. Six of eight tracked KPIs are below target, led by weaker revenue performance and a pressured fiscal balance. Compensation of employees and interest costs were closer to baseline, but the overall opening position shows early fiscal stress that should be watched in the next CGO release.

extras.approved_email_summary: May 2026 remains Under Pressure in the Budget Performance Tracker. Of eight selected central-government KPIs, three are On Track, one is on Watch and four are Under Pressure. The Fiscal Balance is the main pressure point: the year-to-date result was −J$19,721 million, 72.1% more negative than the planned −J$11,460 million. Tax Revenue and Total Revenue & Grants were also below their year-to-date baselines, while Compensation of Employees remained broadly in line. In the next official release, the key questions are whether revenue collections improve and whether the Primary and Fiscal Balance gaps narrow. This assessment covers selected KPIs, not every ministry, programme or public service.
